text:
alex: Hey all — joined today and accepted the org invite, but when I try to push to redwood/infrastructure I get 403. clone works but push denied. anyone seen this?
maya: welcome! quick q — did you accept with your work email (alex@redwood.com) or a personal GH account? we enforce org SAML + 2FA so that can cause weird roles.
alex: accepted with my personal GH (alex-personal) because the invite went to an old gmail alias. My profile in the org shows 'Outside collaborator' so that might be it.
jeremy: yep that's the issue 99% of the time. SCIM/SAML will only map enterprise members if the account matches the verified work email. Outside collaborators get read-only on some repos.
alex: here's the error I see when pushing:
```
remote: Permission to redwood/infrastructure.git denied to alex-personal.
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
```
tess: @jeremy can you re-send to the work email or add the personal account to the right team temporarily? invite-bot usually has a self-serve flow but we avoid granting write to personal accounts.
invite-bot: Re-sent org invite to alex@redwood.com (expires in 7 days) :envelope:
maya: alex — accept that invite then go to https://github.com/organizations/redwood/sso and click 'Authorize' so SSO links your account. Also enable 2FA if prompted. After that we can add you to infra-team (write).
alex: accepted the new invite and completed SSO step, looks like my org role changed to Member. Trying to push again...
maya: give it a minute for SCIM to sync, then run `gh api /orgs/redwood/memberships/alex --jq '.state'` or just try a simple push.
alex: push worked! thanks all. one small ask — how do I request deploy key access for CI?
jeremy: open a ticket in #eng-infra with repo and CI name, and ping me if it's urgent. we prefer using bot deploy keys scoped per-repo. :thumbsup:
